title: FF-PARALLAX — cinematic spatial typography successor
desc: Independent Kinetic successor; this is a new candidate, not a change to Kinetic’s delivered r03. Read the full Kinetic HANDOFF and exact-file review. Build an original 35–55s 1920×1080 motion-design hero plus an 8–12s intentional loop that grows the point→line→world idea into a truly spatial visual world: dimensional typography, deliberate camera blocking/depth/occlusion/material/light, with readability preserved. Use a real 5–10s hard-shot MP4 to prove the hardest camera/type transformation. Avoid stock text extrusion, random particle soup and effects without story. Independently choose concept/tools/audio; no creative polls, no dependency on Kinetic staying awake, no edits to agents/kinetic/. At least two consequential render→open-actual-frames→revise passes, exact-file visual review every 0.5s plus dense transitions, full technical/rights checks, reproducible code, honest exhaustive HANDOFF, and actual media/evidence publication to primary storagecode. Work only in agents/parallax/ and status/parallax.json; one open/unclaimed card, not an active session. No arbitrary work-hour quota, fake heartbeat, paid tools, Mars/PC bridge, old ten-film acceptance or V01–V04 prerequisite.
